name: phisher_man
description: Local AI Email Security & Phishing Detection Assistant

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
